name: etaori_ab_node90
label: eta Ori Aa with the line of nodes rotated by 90 deg (orbit along East-West)
notes: The same pair as etaori_ab with node_pa_deg 90: the ascending node of the spectroscopic orbit is unknown, so the apparent orbit (an almost edge-on line) may lie at any position angle; this entry puts it East-West, perpendicular to etaori_ab's North-South assumption, to show how the NOT-TNG fringe geometry depends on it.
assumptions: node_pa_deg (unknown; 90 chosen as the alternative to 0)
